seo.title: Kaapi Corner · Filter coffee in Indiranagar
seo.description: Filter coffee, idli and fresh bakes on 12th Main, Indiranagar. Open 7 am to 10 pm, every day.

props.headline: Filter coffee, done properly.
props.body: Chicory-free decoction brewed every hour, Chikmagalur beans roasted on Tuesdays, and a dabarah set that arrives frothing. Stay for an idli, or take a flask to the office.

image.alt: South Indian filter coffee in a steel tumbler and dabarah

props.heading: What people come back for
props.intro: A short menu we cook well. Everything is vegetarian; ask us about jaggery instead of sugar.

items.title: Filter kaapi
items.body: Our house decoction with full-cream milk, pulled high in a steel dabarah.

items.title: Ghee podi idli
items.body: Four mini idlis tossed in gunpowder and Nandini ghee, with coconut chutney.

items.title: Cold coffee tonic
items.body: Single-origin espresso over tonic and orange peel. Best on a hot afternoon.

items.title: Banana-walnut loaf
items.body: Baked every morning with Yelakki bananas. Ask for it warm with butter.

images.alt: Wooden tables in a quiet café with morning light
images.caption: The front room at 8 am

images.alt: A cappuccino with latte art on a saucer
Coffee, pastry and juice on a breakfast table
images.caption: Weekend breakfast

images.alt: Pour-over coffee being brewed with a kettle and scale

items.quote: The only filter coffee in Indiranagar that tastes like my grandmother's in Mysuru. I come three times a week.
items.name: Ananya R.

items.quote: Quiet before ten, good wifi and nobody rushes you. The ghee podi idli is the real reason I work from here.
items.name: Karthik S.

items.quote: We ordered two flasks for a team offsite and they were still hot at noon. Lovely people.
items.name: Priya M.

props.heading: Find us
props.body: Two minutes from Indiranagar metro. Street parking on 12th Main after 11 am.
